description: Search Eventbrite events by location and keyword, or read events by URL. Returns one flat row per event with dates, venue, category, organizer, and ticket price range. Refused pages and missing events are free rows. Costs 0.003 USD per event with its page read, 0.0015 USD per event from search only, 0.007 USD per search Eventbrite answers (with or without events), plus 0.026 USD per run start.

event_urls.description: Eventbrite event URLs or event IDs, on any Eventbrite domain. Each event page is read for its organizer and price.

keywords.description: Search words, such as tech, startup, or yoga. Each keyword is searched in each location. Leave empty to list all events in a location.

locations.description: Places to search, one per line: "City, Region" such as "Austin, TX" or "London, United Kingdom", an Eventbrite location slug such as ca--san-francisco, or online. A location Eventbrite does not know returns a free row.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_events.description: The most events to return in this run, across every search and URL, from 1 to 2,000. Default 50. Text or a number.

max_pages_per_search.description: Search pages read for each location and keyword pair, from 1 to 50. A page holds about 20 events. Default 5.

read_details.description: true (default) or false. With true, each event page is read for the organizer name and the ticket price range, at the event row with details price. With false, rows come from search pages only, at the lower event row price, with no organizer name and no price.

start_date_from.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. Search results that start earlier are skipped and not charged.

start_date_to.description: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD. Search results that start later are skipped and not charged.

name: search_eventbrite_events
title: Search Eventbrite events
